index 1e67dde..73ea2eb 100644
--- a/internal/config/config.go
+++ b/internal/config/config.go
@@ -10,6 +10,7 @@ import (
 	"os"
 	"path/filepath"
 	"reflect"

 	"strings"

@@ -31,6 +32,7 @@ var (

 var DecodeHooks = []mapstructure.DecodeHookFunc{
+	envSubstitutionHookFunc(),
 	mapstructure.StringToTimeDurationHookFunc(),
 	stringToSliceHookFunc(),
 	stringToEnumHookFunc(stringToCacheBackend),
@@ -40,6 +42,29 @@ var DecodeHooks = []mapstructure.DecodeHookFunc{
 	stringToEnumHookFunc(stringToAuthMethod),
 }
 
+var envReference = regexp.MustCompile(`^\$\{([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)\}$`)
+
+// envSubstitutionHookFunc resolves exact environment references before other
+// decode hooks convert the resulting string to its destination type.
+func envSubstitutionHookFunc() mapstructure.DecodeHookFunc {
+	return func(from reflect.Kind, to reflect.Kind, data interface{}) (interface{}, error) {
+		if from != reflect.String {
+			return data, nil
+		}
+
+		match := envReference.FindStringSubmatch(reflect.ValueOf(data).String())
+		if match == nil {
+			return data, nil
+		}
+
+		if value, ok := os.LookupEnv(match[1]); ok {
+			return value, nil
+		}
+
+		return data, nil
+	}
+}

+func TestLoadEnvironmentReferences(t *testing.T) {
+	t.Setenv("CONFIG_HTTP_PORT", "8181")
+	t.Setenv("CONFIG_LOG_ENCODING", "json")
+	t.Setenv("CONFIG_CACHE_TTL", "5m")
+	t.Setenv("CONFIG_LOG_LEVEL", "DEBUG")
+
+	path := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "config.yml")
+	err := os.WriteFile(path, []byte(`server:
+  http_port: ${CONFIG_HTTP_PORT}
+log:
+  encoding: ${CONFIG_LOG_ENCODING}
+  level: ${CONFIG_LOG_LEVEL}
+cache:
+  ttl: ${CONFIG_CACHE_TTL}
+`), 0600)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+
+	result, err := Load(context.Background(), path)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	assert.Equal(t, 8181, result.Config.Server.HTTPPort)
+	assert.Equal(t, LogEncodingJSON, result.Config.Log.Encoding)
+	assert.Equal(t, "DEBUG", result.Config.Log.Level)
+	assert.Equal(t, 5*time.Minute, result.Config.Cache.TTL)
+
+	// A normal Flipt environment override still takes precedence over YAML.
+	t.Setenv("FLIPT_SERVER_HTTP_PORT", "8282")
+	t.Setenv("FLIPT_LOG_ENCODING", "console")
+	result, err = Load(context.Background(), path)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	assert.Equal(t, 8282, result.Config.Server.HTTPPort)
+	assert.Equal(t, LogEncodingConsole, result.Config.Log.Encoding)
+}
+
+func TestEnvironmentSubstitutionHook(t *testing.T) {
+	t.Setenv("CONFIG_PRESENT_1", "value")
+	t.Setenv("CONFIG_EMPTY", "")
+	t.Setenv("_CONFIG_PRESENT", "underscore")
+	hook := envSubstitutionHookFunc().(func(reflect.Kind, reflect.Kind, interface{}) (interface{}, error))
+
+	tests := []struct {
+		name  string
+		input interface{}
+		want  interface{}
+	}{
+		{"present", "${CONFIG_PRESENT_1}", "value"},
+		{"empty", "${CONFIG_EMPTY}", ""},
+		{"underscore", "${_CONFIG_PRESENT}", "underscore"},
+		{"missing", "${CONFIG_MISSING_1}", "${CONFIG_MISSING_1}"},
+		{"empty name", "${}", "${}"},
+		{"embedded", "before ${CONFIG_PRESENT_1}", "before ${CONFIG_PRESENT_1}"},
+		{"suffix", "${CONFIG_PRESENT_1} after", "${CONFIG_PRESENT_1} after"},
+		{"invalid start", "${1CONFIG_PRESENT}", "${1CONFIG_PRESENT}"},
+		{"invalid character", "${CONFIG-PRESENT}", "${CONFIG-PRESENT}"},
+		{"non-string", 12, 12},
+		{"named string", LogEncoding("${CONFIG_PRESENT_1}"), "value"},
+	}
+	for _, tt := range tests {
+		t.Run(tt.name, func(t *testing.T) {
+			got, err := hook(reflect.TypeOf(tt.input).Kind(), reflect.String, tt.input)
+			require.NoError(t, err)
+			assert.Equal(t, tt.want, got)
+		})
+	}
+}
